name: Avatar
title: Avatar
summary: A circular picture of a person or partner, shown as a photo, initials or a person icon, with an optional status dot and an overlapping group stack.
whenToUse: Use beside names in testimonials, partner lists, team pages, comments and list rows.
Use the group stack to show "who else" in a compact space (partners in a city, listeners in a group).
whenNotToUse: Do not use for logos, app icons or station artwork; those are square tiles.
Do not use a status dot unless presence is real and live.

props.name: src
props.description: Photo URL. When omitted, initials (from `name` or `initials`) or the person icon show.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name. Used for alt text, the accessible name and default initials and colour.

props.name: initials
props.description: Override the initials, one or two letters.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in px. 40 in list rows, 56 in testimonials, 80 on profiles, 24-32 in dense UI.

props.name: color
props.description: Initials background. Defaults to a colour picked from `name`.

props.name: decorative
props.description: The avatar sits beside the person's visible name, so it is hidden from assistive tech (`alt=""`).

props.name: presence
props.description: Live presence dot. Only use when presence is real.

props.name: presenceLabel
props.description: Word for the presence state ("away"), added to the accessible name. Required with `presence`.

props.name: fallbackLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the person icon fallback when there is no photo or name.

variantNotes: Sizes: `.dp-av-24`, `-32`, `-40`, `-56`, `-80`. Initials scale with the size.
Initial colours: `.dp-av-blue` (`--horizon-blue`), `-violet` (`--gradient-violet`), `-gold` (`--gradient-gold`, dark text), `-ink` (`--charcoal-900`), `-peach` (`--gradient-peach`, dark text).
Status dot `.dp-pres`: online `--success`; `.dp-pres-away` gold; `.dp-pres-off` `--gray-300`. It is 28% of the avatar with a 2px white ring.
Stack: `.dp-stack` overlaps by 10px with a 2px white ring; the count tile is `.dp-av-more`.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Always circular. Never put an avatar in a square or rounded-square frame.
Use 40px in list rows, 56px in testimonial cards, 80px on profile headers, 24–32px in dense UI.
Show at most four faces in a stack, then a count tile.
Pick an initials colour from the name, consistently, so a person keeps one colour.
Use one or two initials, uppercase. No emoji.
Do not use red for presence; offline is grey.
do: Use beside names in testimonials, partner lists, team pages, comments and list rows.
Use the group stack to show "who else" in a compact space (partners in a city, listeners in a group).

accessibility: Decorative avatars next to a visible name get `alt=""`. A standalone avatar gets the person's name as alt.
Initials avatars beside a name need nothing extra; alone, add `role="img"` and `aria-label`.
Never show status with the dot alone; pair it with a word or put it in the label ("Dawit Alemu, away").
A stack needs one `aria-label` listing names and the count.
content: Use real names and roles: "Maria Santos, Partner pastor · Lima, Peru".
Photos are warm and natural, faces centred, no heavy filters.
